g.title: current
g.text: optimize: the steps, in order, and what decides each

g.title: import
g.text: each image's size, format and slots, occupancy

g.title: nw
g.text: (copy what needs no change; keep Draco and meshopt)

g.title: simpq
g.text: quality ≠ Highest, and geometry not all

g.title: large
g.text: (any size, in slow, if the model misses the budget without)

g.title: side
g.text: lowered by 256 until geometry + textures fit 256 MB (not under 1024),
fast: until AVIF fits 6 s at 0.13 s/Mtexel (not under 512)

g.title: tex
g.text: --min-size 512 (0 for the budget) · WebP and AVIF sources decoded

g.title: guard
g.text: output larger than the input, and
less than a tenth of GPU memory saved?

g.title: fail
g.text: A step that fails or is killed is left out (step-failed):
the next goes on from the stage before it.
Only import and export failing fail optimize.
At worst, the output is the model as imported.
